description: Defect: the allowlist holds one entry while allowlistDeclaredSize says 5. The declared size is what makes silent growth impossible - adding an exemption cannot be a one-line edit that nobody notices, because the number has to move with it. The driver must exit 2 with EVIDENCE_ALLOWLIST_SIZE_DRIFT. The entry also names a harness that DOES emit evidence, so this manifest additionally exercises the redundant-entry report.

allowlist.reason: Deliberately disagrees with the declared size, and deliberately names a harness that does emit evidence so the redundant-entry report is exercised too.
allowlist.migrationPending: Nothing: this entry is the defect under test.
